message: The tablet screen part is defined with 'glass' material, causing it to render nearly invisible/transparent in the scene; change its material to 'plastic' with a dark color (#141414) so it is opaque like in the footage.
The dog bed is about 0.8 m too far west from the east wall; in the footage it is tucked right into the north-east corner against the east wall (around x = 4.0 m).

The black storage trunk is about 0.8 m too close to the north wall / cabinet_1; in the footage there are intermediate boxes between cabinet_1 and box_2, so box_2 should be further south around z = 0.2 m.
The tall cardboard box WR26 should be further south along the east wall (around z = 1.1 m) so that it stays immediately south of box_2 and closer to the entrance corner.

The grey blanket part on the backrest overlaps almost identically with the black backrest box, causing severe z-fighting artifacts; offset or thicken the blanket box slightly so it cleanly covers the backrest.
